title: Runbook: Error Handling Conventions
license_note: Synthetic demo content -- not real documentation.
content: Every view function that looks up a record by id should return a clean 404 response when the record is missing, never an unhandled exception. Prefer get_or_404-style helpers over a bare .get() followed by attribute access, which raises AttributeError on a missing row instead of failing cleanly.

title: Runbook: Session Cookie Security
license_note: Synthetic demo content -- not real documentation.
content: Production session cookies must set Secure and HttpOnly. Secure prevents the cookie from being sent over plain HTTP; HttpOnly prevents client-side script from reading it. Both should be the default in the production configuration, not an opt-in flag.
